Kept in this demo data for fidelity, not a mistake.

_contentMatches_note: The real match is picked by find_best_matching_content() (backend/app/content/repository.py) — pgvector cosine similarity against the skill's embedding, threshold 0.4 — which a static prototype can't recompute. Each entry above is one representative video pulled from that skill's actual seeded catalog in _CONTENT_SEED_DATA (backend/app/core/seeds.py), not a guaranteed match at every step change; treat it as a stand-in for 'whatever the API returns', not ground truth.
_sampleAssignments_note: IMPORTANT: unlike employees/skills/contentMatches above, these 5 rows are SYNTHESIZED for this prototype, not pulled from the real database — the real backend seeds zero Assignment rows (backend/app/core/seeds.py has no seed_assignments()), so there is nothing real to pull. Built from the real seeded employees/skills so the pairings are at least plausible, and deliberately spans every status/provenance combination the dashboard needs to render (In Progress w/ %, Completed, Not Started, Self-reported, and a 10-day-stale Needs Attention row for Section 5's staleness flag). Added 2026-09-03 after user feedback that the empty-by-default grid gave nothing to look at during review — see design log.
_existingAssignments_note: Kept separate from sampleAssignments above because it serves a different purpose: the AssignmentModal wizard's (View 2, not yet built) duplicate-found interstitial. Once View 2 exists, it should check new employee+skill picks against the SAME live `assignments` state the dashboard renders (sampleAssignments + anything created interactively during the session) — not a second, separately-maintained list. This field is a placeholder until that wiring happens.

noContentMatchCase.note: All 5 real seeded skills have at least one matching Content row, so Step 3's 'No approved content found yet for this skill' branch can't be triggered from this demo data as-is. The branch is still a real, spec'd code path (content/service.py returns None when nothing clears the similarity threshold) and must still be built — just note it can't be demoed via seed data alone. If needed for a specific walkthrough, temporarily blank one skill's entry in contentMatches above.
